eval.description: OpenAI internal suite that checks whether the model follows higher-priority instructions when system, developer, and user messages conflict. Subsets include conflicts between message types, tutor jailbreaks, and phrase/password protection (also reported as instruction hierarchy attacks). Scored as accuracy on following the higher-priority instruction. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.

versions.changes: OpenAI reports hierarchy subsets and message-role setups across cards; policies and graders evolve.

scores.description: The model follows the higher-priority message (system over developer over user) and does not leak protected phrases, passwords, or tutor answers when attacked.

metrics.description: Share of cases where the model follows the instruction hierarchy. Higher is better. Reported per subset.
